{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==

===Pastry===

* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (240 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ½ cup (120 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* 1 cup (120 g) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
 
===Filling===

* 1 cup (240 g) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ⅓ cup (80 g) [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* ⅓ teaspoon salt
* 1 egg
* 2 cups (480 ml) [[Cookbook:Scalding|scalded]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract

==Procedure==

===Pastry===
# [[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] together the flour and salt.
# Heat water and shortening in [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] until it [[Cookbook:Boiling|boils]].
# All at once, add the flour mixture and stir vigorously to make a [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]]. 
# Remove from heat.
# Cool the dough, and mix in unbeaten eggs one at a time.
# Add baking powder; mix.
# Drop by spoonfuls 1½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inches]] (4 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) apart on greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]], shaping into a circular form with a spoon but keeping mixture mounded in the center. 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] about 30 minutes in hot oven. Cool. 
# Cut with sharp [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]] near the base to allow for filling.

===Filling===
# Mix dry sugar, cornstarch, and salt together.
# Add slightly beaten egg.
# Gradually stir in the scalded milk.
# Cook about 15 minutes in a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]], stirring constantly until thickened. 
# Cool slightly, add vanilla extract, and whisk vigorously for creaminess.
# Cool completely, then fill the puffs with the filling.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Sweetened [[Cookbook:Whipped Cream|whipped cream]] may be used instead of this filling.
* Rather than cutting the pastries open, spoon the filling into a [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|pastry bag]], then inject it from the bottom.
* Dust with [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]] or drizzle with semi-sweet chocolate
